instruction: Set the screen blank delay to 10 minutes in power settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.press('escape'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('escape'); time.sleep(0.3);
